# Template: punnett_square
A 2x2 Punnett square for a monohybrid genetic cross: each parent's two alleles become the row/column gamete headers, every cell shows the resulting offspring genotype with the dominant (uppercase) allele written first, cells sharing the dominant or recessive phenotype are shaded together, and a reduced ratio caption sits under the grid ("3 : 1" for the classic Aa x Aa cross counting phenotypes, or "1 : 2 : 1 genotypes" when no phenotype is highlighted). Choose this scene for ANY request about a Punnett square, a genetic cross, dominant and recessive alleles, genotype vs phenotype ratios, heterozygous or homozygous parents, or Mendelian inheritance.
Parameter schema:
{
 "type": "object",
 "properties": {
  "parent1": {
   "type": "string",
   "description": "Parent 1's two-letter genotype, e.g. \"Aa\" (default \"Aa\")."
  },
  "parent2": {
   "type": "string",
   "description": "Parent 2's two-letter genotype, e.g. \"Aa\" (default \"Aa\")."
  },
  "trait": {
   "type": "object",
   "properties": {
    "dominant": {
     "type": "string"
    },
    "recessive": {
     "type": "string"
    }
   },
   "description": "Trait names for the dominant/recessive alleles, e.g. { dominant: \"brown eyes\", recessive: \"blue eyes\" } — appended to the ratio caption."
  },
  "highlight": {
   "type": "string",
   "enum": [
    "dominant",
    "recessive"
   ],
   "description": "Which phenotype's cells to shade (default \"recessive\"); pass null to shade nothing and show a genotype-count ratio instead."
  },
  "show_ratio": {
   "type": "boolean",
   "description": "Show the ratio caption under the grid (default true)."
  }
 }
}
Element ids your commands can reference:
- grid: the 2x2 grid lines (a group)
- grid__c<r>_<c>: each cell's offspring-genotype text (row 0 = top; kit.table's own ids)
- grid__ch<c> / grid__rh<r>: the column/row gamete-letter headers
- parent1_label: parent 1's caption above the column headers
- parent2_label: parent 2's caption left of the row headers
- hl_<r>_<c>: shaded region behind a highlighted-phenotype cell, present only for those cells when highlight is set
- ratio: the ratio caption under the grid, when show_ratio
Examples:
Request: "Cross two heterozygous parents in a Punnett square." → params: {"parent1":"Aa","parent2":"Aa"}
Request: "Cross a heterozygous parent with a homozygous recessive parent and highlight the dominant phenotype." → params: {"parent1":"Aa","parent2":"aa","highlight":"dominant","trait":{"dominant":"brown eyes","recessive":"blue eyes"}}

In YAML: `template: punnett_square` and `params:` per the schema above; commands name the element ids above.
